test_title: PYST 2: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 27 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends L, M, N, O, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. L is sitting third to the left of O. M is sitting second to the right of O. N is sitting second to the right of P. P is the only one sitting between Q and O. Who is sitting between M and Q?
solution:
1. L is sitting third to the left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0427c0aba263f986bf281f9d058eac96a849acf85334b32cfdbb36426e9139cf.png] 

2. M is sitting second to the right of O

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914ee9b8bf32af6a315766082b9e614b9d60b494dae581ed2c04973238f3c5de.png] 

3. N is sitting second to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/191c65a75df450260a37dd7f4f16ffcb4b8a5f3c9d260d87b62e999e47cd2bbd.png] 

4. P is the only one sitting between Q and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd6ac131ea85e9f1592b39b21519645a29909820e3ec5e71a6e913c708eb56e9.png] 

As we can see the diagram L is sitting between M and Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "L".
